'''Berry jam''' was a treat made from [[Berry/Legends|berries]] the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] were fond of. The young [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]] once offered several jars of that [[jam]] to the [[Shaman/Legends|Shaman]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]], as a gesture of thanks for disinfecting the [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]] that had been [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] by [[Morag]] the [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]].
